text: Most people with bacterial meningitis who are treated quickly will also make a full recovery, although some are left with serious long-term problems. These can include: e hearing_loss or vision loss, which may be partial or total e problems with memory and concentration e recurrent seizures (epilepsy) e co-ordination, movement and balance problems e loss of limbs — amputation of affected limbs is sometimes necessary Overall, it's estimated up to 1 in every 10 cases of bacterial meningitis is fatal.
